topic: Mimiko and Nanako demanded their master's body back in Shibuya, and that scene proves the body was never just a shell
title: Mimiko And Nanako Saw Through The Fake Geto
description: Mimiko and Nanako spoke up in Shibuya when nobody else did, and the imposter refused them. A small chapter 93 scene that says a lot about the body Kenjaku borrowed. Do you think Geto's body ever fought back?
comment: Was Geto's body ever really silent in Shibuya, or did a piece of him fight back? Pick one.
end_text: HOW DID THE FACE STILL WORK?

lines.text: Mimiko and Nanako called out the imposter in Shibuya, and almost nobody noticed.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: Chapter 93. A crowd of civilians, and two voices inside it.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: They demand their master's body back.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: These are the two girls Geto rescued from a village in chapter 77.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: They followed him when he left Jujutsu High behind. Now they're looking at his face with someone else behind it.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: The imposter doesn't hand it over. He just refuses.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: Chapter 91 already hinted at a crack. For a moment, Geto's body took over the imposter's right hand.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: People say the body is just a shell and Kenjaku is fully in charge. But a shell doesn't move on its own.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: That's my read anyway: the body was never completely silent.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: So the girls weren't wrong. They had every reason to know that face.

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: But if even they could tell, how did the same face still work on Gojo?

shot.fallback: two young girls standing in a crowded train station looking at a tall dark haired man

lines.text: Which is why Geto's girls matter in this scene.
